epic.settings: DLSS + DLAA + Frame Gen 2x + Epic + Async Compute

medium.settings: TAAU + ResScale 66 + No Frame Gen + Medium + Async Compute

epic_vs_medium_delta.note: Medium saves 14% TDP, 1.5GB VRAM. DLSS+FrameGen costs ~43W but offloads GPU compute to Tensor cores.

live_toggles.interpretation: Compute spike with flat VRAM — scene complexity increase or shading quality bump. GPU clock rose 69MHz (shader recompile likely).
Power spike with VRAM increase — texture streaming event or quality bump. More watts per cycle without proportional GPU% = heavier shaders per pixel.
More power but LESS utilization and LESS VRAM — classic sign of heavier per-pixel work (GI or post-processing toggle). Each frame costs more but GPU has fewer parallel tasks.
VRAM-to-compute swap — freed 472MB buffer memory, GPU utilization jumped 10%. Likely texture quality reduction or resolution scale change. GPU works harder but uses less memory bandwidth.
GAME EXIT. Full thermal cooldown in ~60 seconds. Idle state: 55°C, 69W, 15% GPU, 1.8GB VRAM. The Zone released its grip.

key_learnings: RTX 5090 at Medium STALKER 2 = 44% TDP. 56% headroom = room for Shadow Cast compute.
DLSS+FrameGen costs ~43W but saves raw GPU compute. Tensor cores do the heavy lifting.
TAAU at 66% ResScale is the Medium baseline — UE5's own temporal upscaler, no NVIDIA AI.
VRAM range 7.2-9.0GB (22-28% of 32GB). 23GB sits unused — massive texture/buffer headroom.
Thermal ceiling never exceeded 69°C on a 600W card. Cooling handles the load effortlessly.
Shader compilation creates detectable clock/power patterns — sourDough can identify compile events.
Toggle #3 pattern (more power, less utilization) reveals per-pixel shader complexity changes.
Toggle #4 pattern (less VRAM, more utilization) reveals VRAM↔compute tradeoffs.
The game's thermal lifecycle: load→warm→hot→toggle→shift→exit→cool in ~20 minutes.

shadow_cast_implications.headroom: 56% TDP unused at Medium = 337W available for Shadow Cast overlay compute
shadow_cast_implications.vram_pool: 23GB VRAM unused = massive shadow surface buffer for multi-display radiation
shadow_cast_implications.paradigm: If STALKER uses 44% of the sun to render its world, Gaia can use the other 56% to cast shadows to every display surface in the organism
shadow_cast_implications.next_step: Profile more games to build the cost table. Then: Shadow Cast allocates GPU budget per-surface.

session_rating.notes: Good first taste. Short session (20 min). 5 toggles detected but some may be scene changes rather than intentional setting toggles. Need longer sessions with deliberate single-setting changes for cleaner deltas. Game exit captured cleanly — full thermal lifecycle visible.

eastgate_digest: eastGate qwen2.5:7b analyzed and confirmed: significant headroom for optimization, shadow mapping potential, shader compilation patterns detectable, cascaded shadow maps recommended as first Shadow Cast technique.
